Secrets in `server.properties` are now hidden. On Minecraft 1.21.9 and later, `management-server-secret` showed in the **YAML** tab, in spec downloads and in clones. It's now treated like the RCON password: it never goes into a spec or the Settings form, a spec that sets it is refused, and a cloned server gets a fresh secret of its own. Any future key ending in `secret` or `password` is hidden the same way. The **Files** tab still shows `server.properties` as it is, for editing a secret by hand. If you've shared a spec from a server with the management server turned on, change its secret.

Testing notes are in the "Hidden secrets" section of [testing-1.1.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.1.0-beta.6/docs/testing-1.1.0.md).
